author: Priya S.
title: So soft and the fit is perfect
body: Ordered size 24 for my 4.5 year old using the size chart and it fits beautifully. The cotton is soft and didn't shrink after washing.

author: Ananya R.
title: Wore it for Diwali — so many compliments
body: The gota work is delicate and the lining means no itching. She danced all evening in it.

author: Rahul M.
title: Lovely kurta, quick delivery
body: Arrived in 2 days. Colour is a gentle sage, exactly like the photos. Sleeves are a touch long but he'll grow into them.

author: Fatima K.
title: Best romper for summer
body: Snaps are easy for night changes and the organic cotton is so breathable. Bought two more colours.

author: Sneha P.
title: Our little gentleman at the wedding
body: The waistcoat set looked so smart. Exchange for a bigger size was smooth and quick.

author: Divya N.
title: Perfect newborn gift
body: Gifted this to my sister — the muslin is beautifully soft and the packaging was so pretty.

author: Meera J.
title: Twirly and pretty
body: Daughter loves twirling in it. Tulle is soft, not scratchy. Would love more colours!

author: Arjun T.
title: Great quality for the price
body: Shirt and shorts both feel premium. Washed many times and still looks new.
